Let \(s=a+b+c\). The incenter is

\[
P=\left(\frac{bc}{s},\frac{bc}{s}\right)
\]

so

\[
PA=\sqrt{\left(\frac{bc}{s}\right)^2+\left(\frac{bc}{s}\right)^2}
=\sqrt2\,\frac{bc}{s}.
\]

The inradius is

\[
r=\frac{\text{area}}{s}=\frac{\frac12 bc}{s}=\frac{bc}{2s}.
\]

Thus \(\frac{bc}{s}=2r\), so

\[
PA=2\sqrt2\,r.
\]

Given \(r=\sqrt{80000}=200\sqrt2\),

\[
PA=2\sqrt2\cdot 200\sqrt2=800.
\]

\[
\boxed{800}
\]
